answer_quote: **No.** Based on the visual evidence in this image, the thin basal line under the epithelium does not appear to be the characteristic black staining of an elastin (e.g., Verhoeff's) preparation; it reads as dark purple/blue, and no clearly black-stained, intact basement membrane is identifiable.
